body: Debenham was born in London in the late 1800s, the daughter of a London Doctor. During the period she was active, she worked as a miniaturist and a sculptor, as well as a painter of whimsical illustrations. She exhibited with the Royal Miniature Society and other art societies/galleries in London as well.
dimensions: Watercolor, 10.5 x 7 inches/Exhibition label on verso
